text: Make a silent 15-second widescreen short in three scenes. A young woman with a curly black bob and yellow raincoat finds a wet park bench. An older man with a white beard and blue coat offers his folded newspaper to sit on. They sit together and smile. Live-action look, sweet rather than cheesy. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
